sources_checked.source: NRL official Finals Week 1 team lists

weather.forecast: Auckland Saturday: around 15C daytime, windy and partly cloudy, south-westerly about 35 km/h, around 10% rain chance with trace rainfall in the Takapuna/Auckland forecast.
weather.decision_effect: No demonstrated team-specific edge. Wind retained as match-variance input, especially for kicking/high-ball execution, without directional weighting.

player_effects: Warriors: Jackson Ford named on bench for first game since Round 16; Leka Halasima returns; Wayde Egan and Kurt Capewell return after Round 27 rest.
Dolphins: Selwyn Cobbo, Kodi Nikorima and Kulikefu Finefeuiaki are officially restored; current official reporting describes Dolphins as full strength for their first finals match.
No new official 24-hour squad reduction for this fixture was visible in the checked NRL late-mail source at capture time; current verified named-squad baseline is retained rather than inferred.
player_statistical_trend_effects: Persistent player layer remains complete for both clubs. No new per-round trend claim is added at this checkpoint without newly exposed official row data.

team_macro.Warriors: Approx +310 season point differential, six straight wins, eight wins from 10 at Go Media Stadium, home final, key personnel restored.
team_macro.Dolphins: Approx +156 season point differential, seven straight wins, current reporting says full strength, beat Warriors 26-24 in Round 17; genuine upset mechanism retained.

matchup_effect: The 2026 head-to-head and both teams' strong recent form keep this materially closer than the season differential alone suggests.
evidence_family_independence: Market movement is not counted as independent corroboration. Season differential, venue/results, official availability and prior head-to-head remain separated evidence families.
adversarial_counter_case: Dolphins have seven straight wins, a prior 2026 win over the Warriors, restored Cobbo/Nikorima/Finefeuiaki and a current market that prices them more strongly than the earlier cycle.
falsification: Reduce the Warriors edge if formal late lists weaken Warriors middle/spine continuity, if Dolphins restored combinations remain intact through later checkpoints while Warriors continuity deteriorates, or if market continues moving against Warriors without independent evidence supporting a 62% position.
prediction_decomposition: wind retained as variance rather than directional evidence
